ruleLine: A=1/11 J=2/12 Q=3/13 K=4/14 -- you choose / jokers are fixed at 15, 20 and 25 / clearing the table is a Zwick, worth 1
selectHint: Pick a hand card, then table cards or builds, then Take / Build / Trail
majorityTied: the card counts were level, so nobody takes the three for the majority
landscapeBanner: Turn your device sideways for a better view
hint.take: this capture picks up scoring cards
hint.trail: nothing is takeable, so trail a card that scores nothing
tutorial.values: Capture goes by matching value, not rank. Aces and court cards each have two and you pick which: A is 1 or 11, J is 2 or 12, Q is 3 or 13, K is 4 or 14.
tutorial.jokers: Jokers are not wild. The three are fixed at 15, 20 and 25 -- you cannot choose -- but they are the biggest scorers at 7, 6 and 5.
tutorial.zwick: A "Zwick" is the bonus for clearing the table, worth 1. It is not the name for taking several groups at once.
tutorial.scoring: A deal is worth exactly 30: jokers 7/6/5, the ten of diamonds 3, the ten of spades, the two of spades and each ace 1, and the majority of cards 3. Level counts leave the three unawarded.
